name: MOUTHWASH

prior: iid effects from g unimodal at zero; finite point-mass plus component mixture; optional mixing-weight penalty
inference_algorithm: OLS effects; factor analysis of residuals; analytic mixture integrals; EM or coordinate ascent for marginal-likelihood fitting of g,z,xi
estimand: EB posterior effect distributions and summaries conditional on fitted g,z,xi
data_input: Normalized sample-by-gene matrix Y and observed design X; OLS estimates and residual factor analysis
